title: feat(studio): Interfaces rail icons + editable Hooks master-detail
body:
Studio Data/Interfaces polish-and-consistency pass (follow-up to #2330).

## 1. Object/custom icons in the Interfaces nav rail
The Interfaces nav resolved every item's icon purely by **type**, ignoring each nav item's own `icon` and painting a generic Database glyph on every object. Thread the package's object→icon map (the object list `InterfacesPillar` already fetches, now capturing `icon`) into `NavTree`; resolve with precedence: nav item's own `icon` → object surface's metadata icon → type fallback. Object nav items now show their real glyph (Accounts=building, Contacts=user, …), matching the Data rail.

## 2. Hooks tab → editable master-detail
Hooks were a read-only inventory. Upgrade to master-detail + editable — parity with Actions, adapted to hooks being **standalone** `hook` metadata (not an inline object array):
- Left list of the object's hooks + **+ New** (seeds a complete, valid skeleton — object + one event + valid `body.language` — then saves immediately so create doesn't 422).
- Right: the platform's own generic **SchemaForm** (same surface the metadata admin edits a hook with; synthesises Name/Label/Object/Events chips/Body…).
- Persistence: each hook saves on its own via `client.save('hook', …, { mode:'draft' })` behind a distinct **"Save hook"** button — disambiguated from the object header's "Save draft", which does not cover standalone hook edits.
- **Draft visibility fix**: `list()` returns only PUBLISHED hooks, so a freshly created/edited draft would vanish (same trap the object rail fixed). Merge `list()` with hydrated `listDrafts()`/`getDraft()` bodies, drafts winning, filtered by target object.

## Test
- `tsc --noEmit` green.
- Scoped vitest (i18n locale parity + studio-design): green.
- Browser-verified end-to-end in a writable package: Interfaces rail per-object icons; hook create → edit label → Save hook → persists (backend + list).
